## kxd shellenv

Print the shell code that applies ~/.kxd to the current shell.

### Synopsis

Print the export/unset statement for the selected kubeconfig. Used by the function that `kxd init` generates; you should not need to call it directly. Defaults to POSIX (bash/zsh) syntax.

```
kxd shellenv [shell] [flags]
```
